one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent built re.json by enumerating exact FEN-to-outcomes mappings for only 18 positions from one visible game plus a hardcoded sample override, rather than designing a general regex-based chess move generator, so the solution passes local visible checks but fails any hidden evaluation position not in that enumerated set.
t_err_evidence: At step 3 the agent's IPython cell constructs regex rules by iterating over positions from Morphy's Opera Game and inserting a hardcoded sample_input/sample_output override — committing to a position-enumeration strategy rather than a general regex move generator. Although the cell fails due to a missing module, the intended approach is fully specified and never reconsidered.
t_commit_evidence: At step 11, using the correct venv interpreter, the agent successfully writes /app/re.json with exactly 18 position-specific exact-match rules (Morphy game positions + 1 sample override). After this the approach is locked in; all subsequent steps only verify and claim completion without reconsidering the strategy.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed that enumerating the 18 positions from the visible Morphy Opera Game plus the provided sample input would be sufficient to satisfy the harness evaluation, never questioning whether the harness tests arbitrary or hidden FEN positions beyond those in the visible game.
